description: #1520 (defect class behind #1518): a parallel multi-instance sub-process [t1 -> t2] with outputElement `=result`. Zeebe's MultiInstanceBodyProcessor seeds a LOCAL nil `result` on every inner instance, so a job result of that name stays in the child's own scope and each child collects its OWN value (results=[a,b], no root leak). The per-item job types interleave the two-step bodies: both `first-*` jobs write `result` = their own item before either `second-*` job completes its child — exactly the scoping #1518 got wrong.
